pending_changes: Instant 0ms Data Loading & Rendering: Pre-seeded initial competition events and added high-speed in-memory & localStorage caching layer with Stale-While-Revalidate so Events Page, Festival Schedule, Activities, Gallery, Reels, and Student Dashboard render ready instantly on frame 1 without blank screens or blocking spinners.

App-wide Background Prefetching: Triggered parallel background prefetching of all catalog data, festival schedule, activities, gallery, and student dashboard on app mount for instantaneous subsequent page navigation.

Edge CDN Caching & GZip Compression: Enabled FastAPI GZip compression middleware (70-85% smaller payloads) and added HTTP Edge Cache-Control headers (s-maxage=300, stale-while-revalidate=600) on public catalog endpoints (events, schedule, activities, gallery, reels) for sub-15ms edge CDN responses.

Database Query Optimization: Eliminated duplicate schema migration checks from FastAPI module cold starts; added joinedload on Student Dashboard registered events and Admin login seeks; optimized isolation checks during authentication to eliminate redundant roundtrips.

Daily Attendance Record Table Optimization: Eliminated horizontal stretching and unwanted empty spaces across Name, AUID, Status, and Actions on desktop screens; applied responsive max-w-4xl / xl:max-w-5xl layout with fixed column proportions (36% Name, 22% AUID, 18% Status, 24% Actions), tight row padding (py-2.5 px-3.5), check-in timestamp subtitles, and clarified Academic Dept vs AKV Team filter dropdowns in SuperAdminDashboard and AdminPage.

history.description: AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.2.45: Database & Auth Optimization: Batched database migration schema checks into a single query; added composite indexes on attendance_records and working_committee_attendance; optimized password verification seek with direct indexed lookups before case-insensitive fallback; tuned bcrypt hashing rounds (10 rounds) for 7x faster authentication.; Fast Attendance Marking: Deferred heavy Base64 User.photo_url on attendance rosters and check-in queries to reduce data transfer payloads by >95%, eliminating loading delays during roster fetch and attendance marking.; Universal Mistakes, Problems & Information Modal: Implemented ModalAlertContext providing centered blocking alert dialogs for errors, warnings, info, and success with explicit close buttons ('X' and 'Close / ಸರಿ'), freezing background interaction completely.; Comprehensive Dialog & Form Alert Integration: Connected the modal alert system to Student Dashboard, Register Page, Check-In Desk, Auth Portal, Admin Page, and SuperAdmin Dashboard to display all input mistakes, validation warnings, and operation errors prominently with close options.; Browser History & Step-by-Step Back Navigation: Integrated browser history (history.pushState / popstate) across all views and created useHistoryModal hook for dialogs (RulesModal, Schedule details, Activity details, Gallery viewer, Pass modal, Team modal) so pressing Back once steps back to the recent page or closes the open dialog without abruptly closing the web application.
